items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 June 2026 11:23am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 02 June 2026 at 11:25am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

Complex areas of low pressure to the west of the British Isles as various frontal zones affect the area.


##Wind##

West or southwest 2 to 4, occasionally variable 3 or less in places, increasing 4 occasionally 5 this evening. Backing south or southwest 4 to 6 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Showers this afternoon and evening. Rain arriving tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 to 6, increasing 6 occasionally 7 for a time Wednesday night. Veering west Thursday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate Wednesday evening, occasionally rough Wednesday night.


##Weather##

Rain clearing to scattered showers Wednesday afternoon, these merging into longer outbreaks of rain overnight into Thursday for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.
